verdict.rationale: Text from items lambda-labs-docs-31, -39 and -40 is sourced directly from https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json, which shows a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for the Lambda Cloud REST API is published and downloadable. That spec covers resource management and webhooks. The probe 404s were on docs.lambda.ai paths, a different host, so they do not contradict the spec's existence, but they do suggest it is not discoverable at conventional docs locations. Missing for 10: discoverable spec at standard docs paths or explicit docs linking to the download, independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness and usability.
